g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters An unauthenticated caller sends GET /rest/products/search?q=. The q value is interpolated into a raw SQL LIKE query at routes/search.ts:23 with only a 200-character cap. A UNION payload can read other tables such as Users with password hashes, and more generally the attacker can alter the query to exfiltrate or modify rows, bypass authentication, or escalate to full database control. C-03 · Juice Shop Express HTTP API No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-002) Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication getUserId reads the user id from security.decode(token) with no signature check; an attacker forges a token with another user's id and the getOrderById tool then returns that user's orders and the prompt names them. C-03 · Juice Shop Express HTTP API Public source available Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-007) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access A signed-in attacker puts another user's ID into the owner field of the request (req.body.UserId and the like); the query trusts it instead of the session identity, so the attacker reads or changes every other user's records — horizontal privilege escalation across all accounts. C-03 · Juice Shop Express HTTP API Regular account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets POST /dataerasure passes req.body.layout to path.resolve and then res.render with the body spread (routes/dataErasure.ts:107, routes/dataErasure.ts:104). A request-controlled path with ../ can read arbitrary files such as /etc/passwd, source or secrets, or write outside the intended root per the scanner; the survey shows local file content disclosure of the first 100 characters. Login is required, and a weak lowercase substring blocklist (ftp, ctf.key, encryptionkeys) is the only control. C-03 · Juice Shop Express HTTP API Regular account required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Profile name evaluated as server code Log in and POST /profile with username=#{process.mainModule.require('child_process').execSync('id')}. C-03 · Juice Shop Express HTTP API Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-001) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers An attacker submits a feedback comment containing HTML/script via the feedback endpoint. The About page fetches all feedback, concatenates the comment into an HTML string, marks it trusted, and renders it with innerHTML, executing the script in every visitor's browser and exposing the localStorage bearer token. C-06 · Angular Client Application Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Dependency Install Scripts Run at Build Time: Without --ignore-scripts, any compromised dependency publisher can execute postinstall code at build time. C-01 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required No weakness linked in the register Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data Disclosure of customer information
